readings: For films with replacement_cost greater than 20.99, calculate for each rating the average length and the average of each film’s rental_rate divided by its replacement_cost, ignoring missing values. Return one row containing the unrounded, equally weighted average of the per-rating average lengths, followed by the unrounded, equally weighted average of the per-rating average ratios.

For films with replacement_cost greater than or equal to 20.99, calculate for each rating the average length and the average of each film’s rental_rate divided by its replacement_cost, ignoring missing values. Return one row containing the unrounded, equally weighted average of the per-rating average lengths, followed by the unrounded, equally weighted average of the per-rating average ratios.
queries:
SELECT AVG(avg_length), AVG(avg_ratio)
FROM (
  SELECT
    AVG(length) AS avg_length,
    AVG(rental_rate / replacement_cost) AS avg_ratio
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99
  GROUP BY rating
)

WITH rating_averages AS (
  SELECT
    rating,
    AVG(length) AS avg_length,
    AVG(1.0 * rental_rate / replacement_cost) AS avg_ratio
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99
  GROUP BY rating
)
SELECT AVG(avg_length), AVG(avg_ratio)
FROM rating_averages
